dse_runs.notes: DDS/NCO sin-cos generator: one sample per clock at >=250 MSPS, max_abs_err <= 2^-13, minimize LUTs (HV ref 4000), maximize accuracy_bits (HV ref 13). Selection rule: min LUTs. Prioritize pipelined families for throughput; keep data widths tight to control LUTs while meeting 13-bit accuracy.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **dds_250msps** was taken down the full fidelity ladder and finalized: L1 used all 400 evaluations in the structured DSE graph (refine → refine → stop), producing a 27-design feasible Pareto front of pipelined CORDICs; L2 system simulation of the top designs confirmed the selection (SFDR 100.5 dBc, SNR 88.3 dB, 17-cycle latency, 1 sample/clock) with no change; L3/L4 had no recorded verification or synthesis rows for the selected design, so L5 back-annotation found no measured data to compare and flagged no winner change (no reexplore needed). Final selection: **pipelined CORDIC, data_width=19, n_iter=15, angle_guard=0, frac_guard=0, rounding=round** — 935 LUTs (estimate), 13.2 accuracy bits, 264 MSPS throughput, max error 2^-13.18, meeting both the ≥250 MSPS throughput and ≤2^-13 error constraints while minimizing LUTs per the spec's selection rule.
